definitions.explanation: Multiple mountains; a range of mountains.
Used to express strong desire, often followed by 'but...' to indicate constraint.

examples.japanese: {遠|とお}くに{山々|やまやま}が{見|み}えます。
examples.english: You can see mountains in the distance.

examples.japanese: {行|い}きたいのは{山々|やまやま}ですが、{時間|じかん}がありません。
examples.english: I'd love to go, but I don't have time.

examples.japanese: {山々|やまやま}に{囲|かこ}まれた{村|むら}。

notes: Has two distinct uses: 1) literal plural of {山|やま}, and 2) adverbial expression meaning 'very much' (often with ～のは{山々|やまやま}だが... pattern expressing that one wants to do something but can't).
